About this site

The Hiking Desk is one person's gear notebook, published as a website. I have been hiking in the Pacific Northwest for sixteen years and writing down what works for most of that time. The desk in the title is real: a wooden desk on the second floor of a house outside Eugene, with a view of a street that is not much to look at.

The rules

No sponsored reviews. If a brand sends gear, it gets returned unopened. Every item reviewed here was bought at retail price with my own money, which is why the review queue moves slowly.

Every review is based on at least three weeks of actual use. The exceptions say so on the page. I do not review gear I have not carried, slept in, or worn until it annoyed me in some specific and describable way.

The fine print

Affiliate links: none. Ads: none. Newsletters: there is a signup box at the bottom of the reviews page, and it goes out about twice a month. Errors in reviews get corrected with a note at the bottom of the post, because gear changes and so do opinions.
